data.one_liner: Zero-dependency package to flatten nested Maps and recover them later.
data.what_it_does: It converts a deeply nested Map and flattens it into a single-depth Map with delimited keys. It also provides an unflatten method to reverse the process.
use_when: You need to flatten nested maps for database storage or query parameters
You want to convert nested JSON structures into single-depth key-value pairs
avoid_when: You need feature parity with the full Node.js flat package (such as transformKey)
Your tree contains types other than Map or List during flattening
strengths: Supports custom delimiters, safe mode for arrays, and maxDepth configuration
Supports null safety and Map<String, dynamic>
weaknesses: Does not achieve full feature parity with the Node.js flat package
Bails out of a tree if it encounters something other than a Map or List
